tasks.question: Using BASF's financial-control 2025 and adjusted 2024 gross Scope 1 and gross market-based Scope 2 emissions, calculate the Scope 1 plus market-based Scope 2 sum for each year and the percentage change from 2024 to 2025 to two decimals; also report the issuer's separate row-level year-on-year changes for gross Scope 1 and gross market-based Scope 2, and do not conflate the calculated Scope 1 plus Scope 2 sum with total market-based emissions including Scope 3.

For financial and operational control, report BASF's 2025 and restated 2024 total energy consumption, renewable energy consumption and share, and fossil energy consumption and share; preserve the control basis, units, and restatement qualification.

For BASF's financial-control 2025 and adjusted 2024 Scope 3 disclosures, report total gross Scope 3, Category 1 purchased goods and services, and Category 12 end-of-life treatment of sold products; sum Categories 1 and 12 and calculate their share of total gross Scope 3 for each year to two decimals, preserving the comparative adjustment qualification.

At December 31, 2025, report BASF's total employees and permanent, temporary and apprentice counts; deterministically sum the three contract categories and compare the result with total employees. Also report the 2025 turnover rate and work-related fatality count, preserving the head-count and safety definitions.

For BASF's 2025 EU Taxonomy sales revenue, capex and opex, report each denominator, the disclosed eligible share, and the aligned amount and share; preserve the discontinued-coatings boundary and distinguish eligible from aligned activities.

Identify the subject, criteria, level, conclusion form and governing standard of BASF's 2025 sustainability assurance; state what information was excluded, how limited assurance differs from reasonable assurance, and identify the assurance provider, location, date and signatories.
